about: The animals Westernesse knows, by their base kind (the owner, 5 November: one canonical file of base animals, one of monsters). Each record is what the catalog chassis makes a creature from: its name, kind and type, what is seen of it, its statistics (rolled or fixed qualities, hit die or fixed hit points, natural weapon and armour, actions), abilities, natural traits, resistances, temperament, habitats and provenance. A record with variantOf is that base with its own fields laid over it. Orsino's animals are read with these from the generated catalog (data/catalog/orsino/species.json), each a kind of its own; a hand record replaces the Orsino one it names in its source. What varies a specimen or a population (age, size, region, role, condition) is a variation (variations.json), not a record here. Schema: src/canon/schema.ts (Species).
